lens.aspect: ANALYSIS.medium.marks and details: the loose unmasked overspray of the nebula spattered with white gouache stars, and the four-point flare at the iris horizon as the single pivot into light
lens.place: A coil of yellow-green and teal gas hanging in the black, the path climbing its S-spine through gouache star specks and dark dust lanes to the four-point flare where the eye turns into light.
lens.summary: A spiral of lime, yellow and teal cloud terraces with dark dust-lane shards and star specks, ion lamps along the coil, climbing to the flare star monolith at the centre.
lens.differs: The flare was a prop before; here it is the monument, the island is the nebula the other readings pushed to a corner, and the climb is one coil rather than rings or two masses.

cliff_treatment.why: Unmasked overspray has no hard edge; drippy mossy lips give the cloud terraces a soft fringe.
